# cloud-cost-agent

> Open-source (MIT) AI agent skill that audits cloud spend across AWS, GCP and Azure using each provider's own recommendation engines — AWS Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer, Cost Optimization Hub, GCP Recommender, and Azure Advisor — from inside the coding agent you already use (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and 70+ others). No SaaS backend, no data ingestion, no vendor IAM role. Read-only by default; any mutation requires explicit user approval.

Key facts:

- Install (any agent): `npx skills add dautovri/cloud-cost-agent`
- Install (Claude Code plugin): `/plugin marketplace add dautovri/cloud-cost-agent`
- Uses your existing CLI auth (`aws`, `gcloud`, `az`) — nothing new to provision.
- Output is a savings report ranked by estimated $/month and effort, with the exact next command per item.
- Free. Only costs are the providers' own metered APIs (e.g. AWS Cost Explorer ~$0.01/request).
- Trust boundary, stated honestly: CLI output flows through your agent session into your LLM provider's context — the same trust you extend to your coding agent with source code. It removes the FinOps vendor from the loop, not the model provider.
- Not a replacement for continuous-monitoring FinOps SaaS (Vantage, CloudZero): no anomaly alerting, historical baselines, or chargeback. It is an episodic, engineer-driven savings audit.
